description.value: Moose Lake is a natural lake within or adjacent to Mount Robson Provincial Park, situated along the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) corridor in eastern BC. The park is one of BC's most celebrated destinations, anchored by Mount Robson at 3,954 m — the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies. Cyclists riding the Yellowhead route pass directly through this dramatic mountain landscape.
